scope: read-only resumption inventory, not new discovery or effectiveness experiment
population_rule: Use existing fixed xkernel discovery inventory and its original IDs; reconcile 43-pair review and historical-case records as provenance/status, not a replacement ranked pool. Identify and freeze concrete inventory path and hashes before source screening. If no reproducible ID/status mapping exists, report failure instead of switching sets.
order: original fixed candidate ID ascending; no score reranking
unresolved_rule: No recorded completed bounded follow-up or definitive source-grounded disposition; provisional review/defer alone does not mean solved. Keep original disposition separate from this navigation decision.
record: all encountered exclusions and admitted IDs, availability of pinned source/docs, development exposure, actionable remaining question; no presumption of positives
stop: first 12 eligible unresolved IDs or inventory end; no backfill beyond cap for unavailable or unfavorable sources
outputs: independent run only; report, lookup, input selection and evidence ledger
